*Note, tiers are still in development and are subject to change.

Outclassed      = theres no reason to ever pick that form.
Outclassed2    = the same as 1, but for characters instead of forms.
Outperformed = that are justifiable with a different upgrade path, but someone can fill their role better.
Optimal?          = that you can make an argument for that form being the optimal one to use.
A = passed initial filter
B = chosen over other form
C = outperformed by B

The stars visually work in one of the following ways
1. One flat increase every time. Ex. All Health and speed. Some characters have a Str or Ki Stat that does this like Vegeta’s Str.
2. An alternating value such as 4 and 5 repeating.
3. A single value and 3 other numbers either higher or lower than it.
4. Regardless of which case, these loop in quantities of 4, so if you cheated more level ups, it would repeat the same 4.
5. Most importantly, the order of the values shuffles on each upgrade, so an upgrade for one form isn’t necessarily the best one for another. Goku in his normal form gets a 6 for his first Str upgrade while its a 5 for his first star in every other form. Normally, this isnt a problem as higher forms regardless will generally have better stats even with a lower upgrade.
6. Str and Ki only alternate because those 2 stats follow an arithmetic sequence of +1, +1, +1, +0 etc Ex. 0, 1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6, 6, 7, etc.
7. In the addresses,  numbers add up exactly in hex, so the above rule must be kept in mind if modifying the rom.

Tiers are chosen based on combat effectiveness; anyone with the outclassed1 or 2 status is separated into a different list.
On a different note, if you just want to choose a character to spam the basic cont punch or basic energy moves, merely look at who has the best max Str or Ki based on what you want.

Standard Upgrade from Tier 1 to 2 is 10HP 4Str 2Ki 2Spd (+0A, +05, +03, +02)
   Vegeta gains 3Ki instead and Ginyu only gets the Str boost.
Tier 2 to Tier 3 has less patterns due to almost everyone having a unique boost, but the non unique boost is generally around this range
   5Hp 1-2Str 1-2Ki 1Spd

Due to how str and ki work, Precise Characters shows the base stats in hex, and the numbers they increase by in decimal to make keeping track of them easier.
